rules.pattern: \bit('s| is) (worth (noting|mentioning)|important to note|important to remember)\b|\bneedless to say\b|\bno discussion would be complete\b|\bthat (being said|said),|\brest assured\b
rules.message: Throat-clearing: the sentence announces that a point is coming instead of making it.

matching: It's worth noting that the API is rate limited

rules.pattern: \bin today('s| is) (fast[- ]paced |digital |modern |ever[- ]changing )?(world|age|era|landscape|economy)\b|\bin (an|the) era of\b|\bin (a|the) world where\b|\bin the (realm|world) of\b
rules.message: Stock era-framing opener. Start with the subject instead.

matching: In today's fast-paced world, teams need speed
in a world where data is cheap

rules.pattern: \bdue to the fact that\b|\bin light of the fact that\b|\bin the event that\b|\bhas the ability to\b|\bat this point in time\b
rules.message: Wordy connective a human editor would collapse ('because', 'if', 'can', 'now'). Narrowed in 0.2.0: 'in terms of', 'with regard to' and 'for the purpose of' were dropped — ordinary human formal English fired them as often as machine prose.

replacements.when: due to the fact that|in light of the fact that

matching: due to the fact that it failed

rules.pattern: \bexperts (say|believe|argue|suggest|agree)\b|\b(studies|research) (show|shows|suggests|have shown)\b|\bobservers (noted|have noted)\b|\bindustry reports\b|\bwidely (regarded|considered|seen) as\b|\bit is (believed|said) that\b|\bmany believe\b|\bsome say\b
rules.message: Weasel attribution: a claim sourced to nobody. Name the study, the report, or the person.

matching: Research shows new hires stay longer
clean: The 2025 DORA report puts the figure at 31 percent.

rules.pattern: \b(could|may|might|can) potentially\b|\bpotentially possibly\b|\bcould possibly\b|\bgenerally speaking\b|\bbroadly speaking\b|\bmore often than not\b|\bfor the most part\b|\bto some extent\b
rules.message: Stacked hedge. One hedge is honest; two is mush. Keep the strongest and drop the rest.

matching: for the most part it works
clean: it holds in the tests we ran

rules.pattern: \b(streamline|empower|supercharge|unleash|revolutioniz|transform) (your|the) (business|team|workflow|potential|power)\b|\bunlock (your|the) (full )?potential\b|\b(harness|leverage) the power\b|\btake it to the next level\b|\bmove the needle\b|\bone[- ]stop shop\b|\bgame[- ]chang(er|ing)\b|\bmission[- ]critical\b|\bfuture[- ]proof\b|\btailored solutions\b
rules.message: SaaS marketing filler. Say what the product does.

clean: the change cut latency by half

rules.pattern: \bthought leader(ship)?\b|\bpain points?\b|\bvalue (add|proposition)\b|\bmoving forward\b|\btouch base\b|\bcircle back\b|\blow[- ]hanging fruit\b|\bsynerg(y|ies)\b|\blearnings\b|\bcommitment to excellence\b|\bbest of breed\b
rules.message: Business jargon. Plain words carry the same meaning and read as written by a person.

clean: what we learned from the outage

rules.pattern: \bi hope this (helps|email finds you well|finds you well)\b|\b(please )?don'?t hesitate to (reach out|ask|contact)\b|\bfeel free to (reach out|ask|adjust|modify|tweak)\b|\bhappy to help\b|\bis there anything else\b|\blet me know if you('d like| have any| need| want)\b|\bwould you like me to\b|\byou('re| are) absolutely right\b|\bwhat a (great|thoughtful) question\b
rules.message: Assistant closer left in the document. A document has no interlocutor.

matching: Let me know if you'd like a longer version
Would you like me to expand this?
clean: Questions go to the operations team.
Ask Priya if the routing rule is unclear.

rules.pattern: \bthe future looks bright\b|\bexciting times (lie ahead|ahead)\b|\bstep in the right direction\b|\bonly time will tell\b|\bthe possibilities are endless\b|\bpoised for growth\b|\bwatch this space\b|\bshaping the future of\b|\bsetting the stage for\b|\bleaves an indelible mark\b|\bspeak for themselves\b|\bthe bottom line is\b
rules.message: Weightless conclusion. End on the last real fact instead.

matching: The future looks bright for the team
clean: The next review is in October.

rules.pattern: \bin this (section|post|article|piece)\b|\bas (we'll|we will) see\b|\bas (mentioned earlier|discussed above)\b|\bwalk you through\b|\blet me explain\b|\bthe rest of this (essay|post|article)\b|\b(plot twist|spoiler):
rules.message: Meta-commentary about the text's own structure. Readers can see the structure.

matching: In this section we cover retries
clean: The reason is the retry budget.

rules.pattern: \bwhat if I told you\b|\bhere('s| is) what I mean\b|\bthink about it\b|\bask yourself\b|\bhear me out\b|\blet that (sink in|marinate)\b|\bbuckle up\b|\bmake no mistake\b|\blet me be clear\b|\bread that again\b|\bfull stop\.
rules.message: Rhetorical setup or emphasis crutch: manufactured weight carrying no information.

matching: What if I told you it was cheaper
Make no mistake: this is a rewrite

rules.pattern: \bthe (implications|consequences|reasons) are (significant|real|structural)\b|\bthe stakes (are high|could ?n('|o)t be higher)\b|\bthe (significance|importance) cannot be overstated\b|\bthe real question is\b|\bwhat really matters\b|\bthe (deeper issue|heart of the matter)\b
rules.message: Vague declarative: announces significance without naming the thing.

matching: The real question is whether it scales
clean: A failure here loses two hours of writes.

rules.pattern: \blet me think\b|\blet('s| us) (reason|work) through\b|^[ \t]*step [1-9]:|\b(first|next|finally), let('s| us)\b|\b(if we )?break(ing)? this down\b|\blet('s| us) (consider|examine)\b
rules.message: Chain-of-thought scaffolding leaked into finished prose.

rules.pattern: \byou('re| are) (asking about|wondering)\b|\byou (want to know|mentioned that)\b|\bgreat (question|observation)\b|\bthat('s| is) an? (interesting|thoughtful|excellent) (question|point)\b|\bI understand you('re| are) looking for\b
rules.message: Acknowledgment loop: the text parrots a question back at a reader who never asked one.

clean: The point holds for batch jobs too.

rules.pattern: \bnavigating the complexities\b|\bplays a (crucial|vital|significant|key) role\b|\bcharacterized by\b|\bunderscores the importance\b
rules.message: GPT-family tic. Off unless the GPT gate is enabled.

matching: plays a crucial role in retention
clean: scaling is hard for three reasons

rules.pattern: \bworth stating plainly\b|\bcarry the argument\b|\bone might argue\b|\bit could be suggested\b|\bI want to make sure\b|\bI should note\b
rules.message: Claude-family tic. Off unless the Claude gate is enabled.
GPT-3.5-era enthusiastic opener; largely gone from current models and shipped off by default.
